$Comment: Orrin's Grimoire, the Disenchanting Tables' EARNED book: Enchanter Orrin hands it over as the claim reward on his own capstone quest, so anyone who sees his story through walks away with a grimoire whether or not the table ever drops the Disenchanter's. It is the lesser of the pair on purpose, one quality step under the trophy (Uncommon to its Rare) with every stat a notch below it, so the chase find keeps its standing. It is a WORKING spellbook: the vanilla grimoire's model, animation set, casting interactions and mana costs, so it casts exactly as the vanilla purple grimoire does. It wears the vanilla brown grimoire's texture and icon so the two books are never confused in a hotbar. One per stack. No Parent and no Recipe, so no vanilla recipe can be inherited and the book stays reward-only; it is not a member of the disenchanter's kit set, whose held tier asks for the trophy itself. Its three stats sit in Weapon.StatModifiers, which the engine applies natively while the book is in hand: RPG_Disenchanting_Proficiency 10 makes the ritual run faster, MMO_Luck_ENCHANTING 15 is plus 15 points of Enchanting luck for every luck-scored roll this pack ships at the tables (the grimoire chase included, since this book can be held while chasing the other), and MMO_BonusXp_ENCHANTING 10 is plus 10 percent Enchanting experience. Every entry is Additive because these channels carry a base of zero. The tables refuse it as input at both tiers through this pack's ProtectLists/Mmo_Disenchanting_Tables_Earned.json, so a book earned is never unmade by accident. Amounts are opening balance; keep them under the Disenchanter's Grimoire if the find is to stay the better book. Tags.ZigLevel asks for Arcana 40 to hold it (the best level the player ever reached), behind MMO Skill Tree's Gear levels switch (Tags.ZigLevelFeature); gear a player already had when gear levels arrived keeps working for them, and a server owner frees or retunes it with a ZigLevel group gate in mods/ziggfreedcommon/use-gates.json.
